name: Eclipse
storyline: Set in August 2017, players follow Jack, a young adult, as he documents abandoned locations with his friends. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors. An ancient power, buried deep under the estate, has an incomprehensible power that can twist Jack's mind to the point where you can no longer tell what's real and what's not.
summary: Eclipse is a new survival horror experience that combines modern horror with classic horror elements. Drawing inspiration from classic horror games, Eclipse delivers a new and fresh take on survival horror.
